title: No release path leaves a story unreachable (#877)

story.i_want_to: every claim release on a delivery story to end somewhere the driver or a human acts on
story.so_that: a crashed or refused dispatch never silently drops its story out of the loop

rationale: Every caller of Stages.follow_release/5 leaves agent_status pending at stage queued, and the driver selects contracted stories only, so the story sits unreachable for ever with no alert. The fix has to be per cause: a refusal is free to retry, a crash costs money, and an operator's release is a human decision. The retry ceiling is spend, so it has no default.

acceptance_criteria.description: A placement refusal (Placement.undo_claim/5) leaves the story queued and contracted, attempts unchanged.
A lease expiry with DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS set to N and fewer than N counted crash attempts leaves the story queued and contracted with the attempt counted.
A lease expiry that reaches the ceiling takes {queued, escalated, :attempts_exhausted} with the count in escalation_reason.
With DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS unset, the first lease expiry escalates over :attempts_exhausted.
A verifier-reject auto-reset and a bulk reject count an attempt and follow the same ceiling.
An operator force-unclaim of a delivery story takes {queued, escalated, :operator_released} and spends no attempt.
A story with no delivery stage row is released exactly as today.

test_cases.name: placement refusal re-contracts for free
steps: DispatchDriver places it; runner replies refused
expected_results: stage queued, agent_status contracted, attempts unchanged

test_cases.name: crash under the ceiling retries
preconditions: config/test.exs sets the dispatch max-attempts key to 2
expected_results: stage queued, agent_status contracted, attempts crash=1

test_cases.name: ceiling reached, and an unset ceiling, escalate
preconditions: pure release-policy function taking cause, counted attempts and ceiling

test_cases.name: verifier reject counts an attempt
preconditions: story reported done under a dispatch
expected_results: attempts incremented; queued and contracted under the ceiling

test_cases.name: operator release escalates
expected_results: stage escalated, edge operator_released, attempts unchanged

test_cases.name: non-delivery story untouched
preconditions: claimed story with no stage row
expected_results: agent_status pending as today; no stage row created

technical_notes: Callers of follow_release/5: progress.ex:1189, :1637, :2931, :3601; bulk_operations.ex:610. Decide by the release cause each already passes, not by caller identity
Re-contract through Escalations' existing recontract/3 (escalations.ex:436), made public, never a second writer of agent_status

New control-only edges in StageMachine: {queued, escalated, :attempts_exhausted} and {queued, escalated, :operator_released}; add both to the contract's stage_transitions table and the escalation reason codes
DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS: row in deploy/FLY_SECRETS.md stating it has no default and what unset means; config read with no fallback, mirroring DISPATCH_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS
Tests set the config key in config/test.exs; never Application.put_env in a test file
Put the per-cause decision in a pure function (cause, attempts, ceiling) so the unset-ceiling case is unit-tested without varying application config
non_goals: Does not change the lease length (US-44.5)
Does not add alerting beyond the escalated queue
